fieldData.awb---integration-feature-1:
Knife 301 is spot 1 on the waitlist

Tavish Forge hammers out one run of 300 chef's knives at $145 each, and the form says the run ships the week of Jan 11. Every knife after 300 goes to the waitlist for the next run. Winnifred Mabe places order 301 and becomes spot 1.

acrm---key-feature-2-image.alt: Tavish Forge's run of 300 chef's knives at $145 has sold out, so Winnifred Mabe's order 301 becomes spot 1 on the waitlist while the run ships the week of Jan 11.
